assessment: This paper used a reconstitution approach to show that in vitro reconstituted PSD condensates can promote actin polymerization and filamentous actin bundling in the absence of other actin regulatory proteins. The authors further show that the EVH1 domain of Homer is responsible for this activity, which is also regulated by CaMKII. Together, this convincing evidence provides the fundamental insight that the crosstalk between PSD and the spine cytoskeleton may be modulated by targeting the phase separation of the PSD condensates.
